div.div: Name each number by a letter and combine them: a / b * 100 is a rate, a - b a difference. Division by zero gives 0.
One point per record: the first measure across, the second up. "Points" times five records are drawn, biggest first.
A bullet reads left to right: the bar is the value, the mark the target, the shading how far there is to go.
Give a number a period field and it gets a sparkline and a comparison; a target turns it into progress.
Anything past Points is folded into "Others". Clicking a part on the board focuses every card of the same model on it.
Two different fields are crossed: one for the rows or bars, one for the pieces, cells or columns.
Inside a period the line covers every bucket, empty ones included; over all time it draws the last twelve.
A list ranks the records by the measure; without one it shows the newest first.
A note needs no model. Use it for a heading, an explanation or a reminder between the cards.
